wallet.short: EncryptLock wallet: every transaction is signed with both keys (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65)
flag.lang: Language of the messages (%s). Default: the %s environment variable, then English
create.short: Create a new wallet (24 recovery words)
create.words_warning: Write these 24 recovery words on paper and keep them safe. Anyone who has them controls the wallet; without them, a lost device means lost coins:
create.next: Next step: register the wallet so it can receive transfers (free): lockkeeper wallet register %s
recover.short: Recover a wallet from its 24 recovery words
recover.prompt: Type the 24 recovery words, separated by spaces, and press Enter:
register.short: Register a wallet so it can receive transfers (free)
register.done: %s is registered and can now receive transfers.
balance.short: Show the balance of a wallet
send.short: Send LOCK; the recipient has 1 hour to accept, otherwise it comes back
send.done: Transfer #%d created: %s LOCK from %s to %s. The recipient has 1 hour to accept.
send.done_vault: Transfer #%d created: %s LOCK from %s to %s. It comes from a Sovereign Vault: the recipient can accept it from %s (for 1 hour); until then the vault can cancel.
send.fee: Fee paid by %s: %s LOCK (development fund %s, LockKeepers %s). It is not refunded.
send.not_registered: %s is not registered: it cannot receive transfers.
pending.short: List pending transfers sent and received
pending.received_header: Received by %s, waiting for you to accept:
accept.short: Accept a transfer sent to you
cancel.short: Cancel a transfer you sent, while it is pending
cancel.done: Transfer #%d canceled; the amount went back to %s.
rewards.short: Withdraw the LockKeeper rewards of a wallet
send.awaiting: This is a new contact or a large amount: the second device of %s must approve within 24 hours, then the recipient has 1 hour to accept.
device.short: Link a second device that can approve and freeze ("none" removes it)
device.scheduled: The second device of %s changes to %s on %s (changes take 7 days).
limits.short: Set the daily limit and the amount above which the second device must approve (0 = none)
limits.done: Daily limit: %s. Second device approval above: %s.
limits.scheduled: Looser values only apply after 48 hours (on %s).
freeze.short: "Not me": freeze the account and send back every pending transfer (account or second device)
freeze.done: %s is frozen. %d pending transfer(s) went back.
unfreeze.short: Ask to unfreeze (account and second device together: at once; one alone: 7 days)
unfreeze.scheduled: %s unfreezes on %s, or at once if the other key also asks.
approve.short: Approve, with the second device, a transfer waiting for it
approve.done: Transfer #%d approved. The recipient now has 1 hour to accept.
shield.short: Show the security settings of an account
shield.daily: Daily limit: %s (used in the current 24 hours: %s LOCK)
shield.approval: Second device approval: new contacts and amounts above %s
heirs.short: Set heirs (address:percent ...) and the days without a sign of life before they can claim (at least 365)
heirs.done: Heirs of %s set. They can claim after %d days without a sign of life.
guardians.short: Set trusted people who can move your coins to a new account if you lose everything (at least 2 must approve)
guardians.done: Trusted people of %s set: %d of %d must approve a recovery.
plan.scheduled: This changes an existing plan: it applies on %s (7 days). You can cancel it with cancel-claims.
alive.short: "I'm here": a sign of life (cancels an inheritance claim)
claim.short: As an heir, claim the inheritance of an account without a sign of life
claim.done: Inheritance of %s claimed. The coins move on %s unless the owner shows a sign of life.
claim.progress: Confirmation recorded: %d of %d heirs. The others have until %s to confirm.
flag.must_confirm: How many heirs must confirm the claim (0 = all)
recover_approve.short: As a trusted person, approve moving an account's coins to the owner's new account
recover_approve.started: Enough trusted people approved. The coins move to %s on %s unless the owner cancels.
cancel_claims.short: Cancel an inheritance claim, a recovery or a plan change on your account
cancel_claims.done: Claims, recovery approvals and plan changes of %s canceled.
recovery.short: Show heirs, trusted people and running claims of an account
recovery.heirs: Heirs (after %d days without a sign of life):
recovery.none: No heirs and no trusted people.
chain.recovery.2: Invalid plan (check the percentages, the days and the number of trusted people).
chain.recovery.3: This account has no heirs or trusted people.
chain.recovery.4: You are not an heir of this account.
chain.recovery.5: You are not a trusted person of this account.
chain.recovery.6: This account showed a sign of life too recently.
chain.recovery.7: A claim is already running for this account.
chain.recovery.8: That account must be registered first.
vault.short: Make the account a Sovereign Vault: every outgoing transfer waits this many days (7 to 365; 0 stops it)
vault.done: %s is a Sovereign Vault: outgoing transfers wait %d days before they can be accepted.
vault.scheduled: A shorter delay only applies on %s.
lock.short: Lock LOCK until a date (YYYY-MM-DD); nobody can move them before, then they come back automatically
locks.short: List the locks of an account
reserves.short: Proof of reserves: how much an account has locked until at least a date (YYYY-MM-DD)
reserves.line: %s holds at least %s LOCK locked until %s.
team.short: Create a team account (e.g. a vault with 3 of 5 keys) from existing wallets
team.done:
Team account %s created: %d of %d members must sign.
Address: %s
chain.transfers.16: This transfer comes from a Sovereign Vault and cannot be accepted yet.
chain.transfers.17: A vault delay must be between 7 and 365 days, or 0.
chain.vault.2: Invalid lock: at least 0.01 LOCK, at most 100 locks per account, and the date in the future (at most 10 years).
chain.transfers.2: The recipient is not registered: it cannot receive transfers.
chain.transfers.4: The amount must be greater than zero.
chain.transfers.5: There is no pending transfer with that number.
chain.transfers.6: Only the recipient can accept this transfer.
chain.transfers.7: Only the sender can cancel this transfer.
chain.transfers.8: The time to accept has ended; the amount goes back to the sender.
chain.transfers.9: This account is frozen ("Not me"): it cannot send.
chain.transfers.10: This transfer goes over the daily limit.
chain.transfers.11: This transfer is waiting for the sender's second device to approve it.
chain.transfers.12: Only the account or its second device can do this.
chain.transfers.13: This transfer does not need approval.
chain.transfers.15: The second device must be another account.
chain.sdk.5: Not enough balance (the amount plus the fee).
chain.sdk.4: Signature not accepted (both keys must sign).
err.no_wallet: There is no wallet called %q on this computer.
err.amount: Invalid amount %q: use a number of LOCK with at most 8 decimals (for example 2 or 0.5).
err.not_enough_keys: Not enough keys on this computer to sign for %s: %d of %d needed.
err.timeout: The transaction was sent but did not appear in a block within %d seconds (hash %s).
err.words: The recovery phrase must have 24 words.
err.already_here: This wallet already exists on this computer under another name.
autocollect.short: Every hour, move a LockKeeper's earnings into its balance; when it was switched off, bring it back (runs until stopped)
helper.short: Let this computer's helper account say "I am on" for the LockKeeper of a wallet
helper.done: The helper %s now says "I am on" for this LockKeeper.
autocollect.started: Automatic collection on for %s: every hour the earnings go into the balance.
autocollect.failed: This round could not collect (tries again in an hour): %s
autoreturn.done: %s is back among the LockKeepers that make the blocks (it had left while switched off, losing nothing).
autoreturn.failed: Could not check whether this LockKeeper is back (tries again in a minute): %s
heartbeat.failed: Could not tell the network this LockKeeper is on (tries again in a minute): %s
chain.transfers.18: A Sovereign Vault cannot sell directly: send the LOCK to a normal account first (with the vault delay).
chain.registry.4: Too busy right now: try again in a moment.
chain.rotation.6: This computer's security chip is not proven: the network does not accept its "I am on".
